business_problem: Garanti BBVA wanted its mobile banking assistant to handle customer requests more naturally, keep context across interactions, and provide more personalized support for common banking tasks instead of limited, less contextual chatbot exchanges.
solution_summary: Garanti BBVA upgraded Ugi, the smart assistant in its mobile app, with generative artificial intelligence based on large language models to improve digital banking support. The implementation serves customers directly inside the bank’s mobile app, where Ugi handles conversational requests and keeps context across interactions so exchanges feel more natural and empathetic. The source says the system learns continuously from user transactions, requests, and feedback, indicating an ingestion loop from operational banking activity and customer interactions into the assistant’s improvement process. Ugi now supports card applications, credit card payments, card-password tasks, wire transfers, and general information, showing integration with core retail banking workflows. The article does not name external model vendors, storage platforms, or orchestration tools, so the solution is best described as an in-house LLM-powered assistant embedded in Garanti BBVA’s digital banking channel.

solution_components.name: Ugi
solution_components.role: Garanti BBVA’s mobile banking smart assistant uses generative AI to manage contextual, personalized customer conversations and support common banking tasks.

data_flow: Customer conversations in the Garanti BBVA mobile app, along with transaction, request, and feedback signals, are used by Ugi’s large-language-model-based generative AI to interpret intent, retain context across exchanges, and return personalized answers or assistance for banking tasks such as card services and wire transfers.
integration_points: Credit and debit card application workflows
business_outcome: The upgraded assistant delivers a more natural and empathetic customer experience, broadens the set of supported banking tasks, proactively suggests solutions, and also contributes to internal productivity gains by automating document scanning, information extraction, summarization, and reporting in other business processes.
architecture_clues: Delivered through the Garanti BBVA mobile app
Uses generative AI based on large language models
Continuously learns from user transactions, requests and feedback
Supports card applications, credit card payments, card-password tasks, wire transfers, and general information
